alt_text: Two men in business attire look at a smartphone together in a bright modern meeting room with large windows and a long wooden conference table. in Bosque de Chapultepec. Text on the image: "I'm used to working" vs "I used to work"
caption:
"I'm used to working" vs "I used to work". • be used to + -ing = familiar with
• used to + verb = a past habit
• I'm used to working late.
• I used to work late.
